drafts.body:
# Why small channels stall (made-up demo)

*Paid partnership with Brindle Coffee.*

Why do most small channels stall at a thousand subscribers? I spent a year finding out. The answer surprised me, and it is not the algorithm. Right, back to the channels. You only need three things: a clear promise, a steady schedule, and titles that say what is inside.

Most people get the first one wrong. They promise everything, so nobody knows why to subscribe. Here is the mistake I made for six months, and how I fixed it in a week. I wrote one sentence that said who the channel was for, and I put it everywhere. Subscribers doubled in two months.

That is the whole trick. If this helped, tell me what your one sentence is.

# Why small channels stall (made-up demo)

*Paid partnership with Brindle Coffee.*

Why do most small channels stall at a thousand subscribers? I spent a year finding out. The answer surprised me, and it is not the algorithm. Right, back to the channels. You only need three things: a clear promise, a steady schedule, and titles that say what is inside.

Most people get the first one wrong. They promise everything, so nobody knows why to subscribe. Here is the mistake I made for six months, and how I fixed it in a week. I wrote one sentence that said who the channel was for, and I put it everywhere. Subscribers doubled in two months.

That is the whole trick. If this helped, tell me what your one sentence is.
